messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: NIPS prob programming workshop
parts:
There's going to be another probabilistic programming
workshop at NIPS this year.

Abstract deadline is Nov 1, but that's the only info on
the site --- no submission instructions:

http://probabilistic-programming.org/wiki/NIPS*2014_Workshop

- Bob

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] NIPS prob programming workshop
parts:
Dave Hogg tweeted today “OH at #CampHogg group meeting "all models are wrong, some are auto-differentiable in C++”” and I think it’s an important point. We need to keep Stan in the probabilistic programming conversation to add some pragmatism to the abstraction that everyone loves. If somebody is up for it then we might as well just email Vikash et al directly with out interest.

It’s nominally parallel to the workshop I have to attend, but there’s enough of us around that we should make some appearance.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] NIPS prob programming workshop
parts:
Vikash invited me to speak at this in July so if he’s the organizer of the workshop, it must be the one I was invited to, so it looks like it’s a go for Stan. I don’t think I have to be the Stan person to speak on this; if others of you are there, it could make sense for one of you to do it, since I’m already committed to so much travel as it is.
A
